questions.question: When God divided the land of Israel among the twelve tribes, whose name received two portions?
When God divided the land of Israel, who besides the twelve tribes also received an inheritance in it?

answers.text: Foreigners who live among Israel and have children
Kings of the nations who make peace with Israel
Merchants who come through to trade with Israel
